violation_type.title: Additional Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Children's Names and Ages (26 TAC §747.1501(c)(3))
violation_type.short_title: Additional Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Children's Names and Ages
violation_type.typical_finding: The permit holder did not know the names and ages of the seven children in care when being asked during the inspection.

finding_variants.text: The permit holder did not know the names and ages of the seven children in care when being asked during the inspection.
Caregiver supervising children did not know children's names nor ages.
